_schema._doc: The one global set of design numbers for the Kanto 151 under energy v2. gen.py writes the move numbers from it; the battle simulator reads it. The engine's own numbers (focus defaults, slots, damage, matchups, the counter table) stay in battle_config.json; this file never repeats them. Change a number here and rerun tools/native/kanto151/gen.py, or tune a single move in moves_kanto.json.
_schema.power_per_chip: power per chip by tier and rarity: a fixed-cost move's power = chips x power_per_chip[tier][rarity] x chip_scaling x the move's power_mods product; a finisher's power (its base) = finisher_base[rarity] x mods and its power_per_chip = power_per_chip.finisher[rarity] x mods
_schema.finisher_base: a finisher's base power by rarity (x mods)
_schema.chip_scaling: a little more per chip as the cost grows
_schema.game_power_ref: the game power each chip count stands for
_schema.game_power_blend: how much of the game power's spread inside a chip bracket survives (an exponent), clamped by game_power_clamp
_schema.accuracy_k: power x (1 + (100 - accuracy) x k): less accurate moves hit harder (a never-miss move, accuracy 0, counts as 100)
_schema.two_phase_mult: two-phase moves are stronger per chip
_schema.hits_state_mult: per unreachable state a move can hit
_schema.tolerance: how far a move's power may drift from the formula before the test fails (hand tuning room)
_schema.shared_power_mult: species efficiency: a shared (non-signature) move's power x this for the user's rarity (signature moves already carry their rarity); for the engine and simulator to apply
_schema.off_pool: a typed cost the user has no pool for: paid in Colorless at this power (for the engine to add; until then such moves are unpayable)
_schema.disrupt_per_chip: focus points a disruption move takes per chip, by rarity (install() writes each move's into battle_config disruption.moves)
_schema.reaction: reaction numbers: return_mult (a counter's mult by rarity), bide_mult, guard_reduce, default_chance (percent)
_schema.combo_power_pct: the extra power a combo gives, by the move's rarity
_schema.focus: the design's focus layer over battle_config focus: rarity_gain_bonus, rarity_resist_bonus, resist_cap, and the amounts focus_up / focus_down_self / focus_drain move
_schema.learn_levels: levels after the stage's first level at which designed (TCG, anime) moves are learned, by tier
_schema.type_map: main-series type -> energy kind (also kanto151.json type_energy)
_schema.effects: every effect tag (engine names): power_mult (the weight on a damaging move's power), doc, and its numbers
_schema.chance_scaled_tags: for these tags the weight is scaled by the move's chance: w' = 1 - (1 - power_mult) x chance; power_mods.effects is the product of the (scaled) weights
_schema.counter_rows_extra: rows the design adds to battle_config counters.rows (install() appends them): Smack Down, Dimensional Hand, Multishot Lightning, Hurricane; Feint reaches a charging foe
_schema.matchups: attacker energy -> defender card type, counted from the species data: weak (has that Weakness), resist, of (species with that card type)
_schema.matchup_summary: the same, read off: x2 when most of that type are weak to it, resisted when most resist it, else the counts
_schema.sim_targets: what the battle simulator checks the meta against

_notes: TCG data: the Pokémon TCG API's Scarlet & Violet 151 set (sv3pt5, 2023), which prints every one of the 151 with current types, weakness, resistance and rarity. Older eras differ; see each species' _notes.

Game data: PokeAPI, every move each species can learn in any main-series game (level-up, TM/HM, tutor, egg). Learn levels come from the Kanto-era games first (Yellow, Red/Blue, FireRed/LeafGreen, Let's Go), then the newest game.

The TCG weakness chain is followed: Water beats Fire, Lightning beats Water, Fire beats Grass, Grass beats Fighting, Fighting beats Lightning, Darkness and Colorless, Darkness beats Psychic, Metal beats the Psychic-type fairies.

reaction.lock: the move's chips stay locked until the foe's next attack or the next turn

absorb_type.doc: Skill: one energy type's moves heal or power it instead of hurting.

acc_down.doc: Lowers the foe's accuracy one stage.

acc_down_aura.doc: Skill: foes are a little less accurate.

acc_down_big.doc: Sharply lowers the foe's accuracy (two stages).

acc_guard.doc: Skill: its accuracy can't be lowered.

acc_up.doc: Raises its own accuracy one stage.

acc_up_big.doc: Sharply raises its own accuracy (two stages).

all_up_chance.doc: May raise all its stats one stage.

atk_down.doc: Lowers the foe's attack one stage.

atk_down_big.doc: Sharply lowers the foe's attack (two stages).

atk_down_self.doc: Lowers its own attack after the attack.

atk_max.doc: Maxes its attack at the cost of half its HP.

atk_up.doc: Raises its own attack one stage.

atk_up_big.doc: Sharply raises its own attack (two stages).

average_hp.doc: Averages its HP with the foe's.

average_stats.doc: Averages its stats with the foe's.

bad_poison.doc: Bad poison: damage that grows each turn.

bonus_if_matched.doc: Far stronger when its chip count matches the foe's.

bonus_per_foe_chip.doc: Stronger for every chip the foe holds.

bonus_per_own_pool.doc: Stronger for every chip it holds in its own type's pool.

bonus_vs_boosted.doc: Stronger against a foe with raised stats.

bonus_vs_damaged.doc: Much stronger against a damaged foe.

burn.doc: Burn: damage each turn; physical power down.

sure_hit.doc: Mind Reader / Lock-On: the foe's next Dodge (or evasion) fails.

chip_drain.doc: The foe loses one unspent chip.

chip_gain.doc: Gains a chip now, into its primary pool.

chip_gain_any.doc: Gains a chip now, into any pool it picks.

chip_gift.doc: Gives the foe a chip (a trick for combos that need the foe's chips).

chip_on_evolve.doc: Skill: gains chips when it evolves mid-battle.

chip_on_faint.doc: Skill: when a teammate faints it keeps one of its chips.

cleanse.doc: Wipes every stat change on both sides.

clear_field.doc: Clears traps, seeds and hazards on its side.

coin_bonus.doc: On a coin flip, much more damage.

confuse.doc: Confusion: may hit itself for 2 to 5 turns.

contact_status.doc: Skill: a physical hit on it may give the attacker a status condition.

copy_move.doc: Uses the foe's last move (or one of its moves).

counter_on_hit.doc: Skill: when hit, deals a little damage back.

crit_immune.doc: Skill: no critical hits against it.

crit_next.doc: Its next move is a sure critical hit.

crit_up.doc: Raises its own critical-hit rate one stage.

cure_status_out.doc: Skill: its status conditions heal after the battle or when it disengages.

damage_reduce.doc: Skill: takes less damage from every attack.

def_down.doc: Lowers the foe's defense one stage.

def_down2.doc: Sharply lowers the foe's defense (two stages).

def_down_self.doc: Lowers its own defense after the attack.

def_up.doc: Raises its own defense one stage.

def_up_big.doc: Sharply raises its own defense (two stages).

delayed_damage.doc: Extra damage at the end of the foe's next turn.

disable_lite.doc: Saps the foe: its last move costs a chip more next turn.

disrupt.doc: Disruption: lowers the foe's focus by the move's disrupt (battle_config disruption.moves), less its disrupt_resist.

disrupt_guard.doc: Skill: disruption and flinching rattle it less.

download.doc: Skill: raises attack or special attack to beat the foe's weaker defense.

absorb.doc: Heals by half the damage dealt.

drowsy.doc: Drowsy: falls asleep at the end of the next turn.

effect_immune.doc: Skill: immune to the side effects of attacks.

encore.doc: Encore: the foe repeats its last move.

endure_chance.doc: Skill: may survive a knockout with 1 HP.

evasion_aura.doc: Skill: harder to hit in its weather.

evasion_down.doc: Lowers the foe's evasion one stage.

evasion_down_big.doc: Sharply lowers the foe's evasion (two stages).

evasion_up.doc: Raises its own evasion one stage.

evasion_up_big.doc: Sharply raises its own evasion (two stages).

faint_blast.doc: Skill: on fainting, may damage the foe heavily.

first_turn.doc: Only on its first action of the battle.

flinch.doc: Flinch: if it moves first, the foe loses its next action.

focus_drain.doc: Lowers the foe's focus (balance focus.focus_drain_amount), on top of any disrupt.

focus_start.doc: Skill: starts the battle with extra focus.

foe_cost_up.doc: The foe's moves cost a chip more next turn.

foe_spatk_up.doc: Raises the foe's special attack (a gamble).

foe_spdef_up.doc: Raises the foe's special defense (a gamble).

force_out.doc: Drives the foe off: a wild one flees or disengages; Roar and Whirlwind also pull it out of a two-phase move.

identify.doc: Normal and Fighting moves can hit Ghosts; evasion is ignored.

foresight_skill.doc: Skill: its Normal and Fighting moves always hit Ghosts.

freeze.doc: Freeze: can't act until it thaws.

gravity.doc: Grounds everything for 5 turns: Fly and Bounce can't be used.

grounds.doc: Knocks a flyer out of the sky and ends Fly or Bounce.

hazard.doc: Lays a hazard that hurts the foe when it comes back in.

heal_delayed.doc: Restores half its max HP at the end of the next turn.

heal_next.doc: Fully heals the next Pokémon to come in.

heal_over_time.doc: Restores a little HP every turn.

heal_per_turn.doc: Skill: heals a little every turn.

hits_fleeing.doc: Double power on a foe that tries to flee or disengage.

indirect_immune.doc: Skill: only direct attacks hurt it.

intimidate.doc: Skill: as the battle opens, the foe's attack and focus drop.

item_play.doc: A held-item trick (held items are a later hook; until then it is just a hit).

justified.doc: Skill: a Darkness hit raises its attack.

ko_boost.doc: Skill: attack up after it knocks a foe out.

last_mover_power.doc: Skill: x1.3 when it acts after the foe.

drain.doc: Leech Seed: drains HP each turn.

levitate.doc: Immune to Ground moves for 5 turns.

low_hp_boost.doc: Stronger the lower its HP (up to double).

luck_up.doc: Skill: coin flips go its way more often.

marvel_scale.doc: Skill: defense x1.5 with a status condition.

mist.doc: Its stats can't be lowered for 5 turns.

multi_hit.doc: Hits several times; power is the total for the usual number of hits.

multiscale.doc: Skill: half damage while at full HP.

needs_others.doc: Only after it has used every other equipped move.

needs_stockpile.doc: Needs Stockpile first; scales with it.

nightmare.doc: Nightmare: a sleeping foe loses HP each turn.

no_crit.doc: No critical hits against it for 5 turns.

no_guard.doc: Skill: every move hits, its own and the foe's.

ohko.doc: A one-hit knockout if it lands (it fails on a higher-level foe); accuracy rises 1 per level above the foe.

para.doc: Paralysis: may lose its turn; speed down.

partner_cost_discount.doc: Skill: with its partner on the team, typed costs drop by one.

partner_power.doc: Skill: its partner's attacks hit harder.

pass_boosts.doc: Keeps its stat changes for the next Pokémon (or the next battle phase).

pass_status.doc: Passes its status condition to the foe.

perish.doc: Perish Song: both faint in 3 turns unless they leave.

pinch_power.doc: Skill: its own-type moves x1.5 below a third of its HP.

pivot.doc: Hits, then it may disengage or swap out.

power_grows.doc: Grows stronger with each use in a row (up to double).

power_up_next.doc: Its next move does half again more.

pressure.doc: Skill: the foe gains less focus each turn.

protect_if_matched.doc: Skill: no damage from attacks when its chips match the foe's.

rage.doc: Attack rises each time it is hit while raging.

random_own.doc: Uses one of its own moves at random.

random_power.doc: Power varies at random (half to one and a half).

recharge.doc: Must rest next turn: its chips don't refresh.

recoil.doc: Takes a share of the damage dealt.

rest.doc: Sleeps two turns and heals fully.

retype_resist.doc: Changes to a type that resists the foe's last move.

reveal_plan.doc: Skill: sees the foe's planned moves each turn.

rival_power.doc: Skill: stronger against its own species line.

seal.doc: Seals the foe: it can't use attack moves next turn (taunt, torment, embargo and the like).

self_confused_only.doc: Only works while it is confused.

set_weakness.doc: Sets the foe's weakness to an energy type of the user's choice.

shed_skin.doc: Skill: a third of the time it sheds a status condition each turn.

sheer_force.doc: Skill: moves with side effects drop them for power.

sleep.doc: Sleep: can't act for 1 to 3 turns.

sleep_on_evolve.doc: Skill: the foe falls asleep when it evolves.

sleep_only.doc: Only works on (or while) a sleeping Pokémon.

spatk_down.doc: Lowers the foe's special attack one stage.

spatk_down_big.doc: Sharply lowers the foe's special attack (two stages).

spatk_down_self.doc: Lowers its own special attack after the attack.

spatk_up.doc: Raises its own special attack one stage.

spatk_up_big.doc: Sharply raises its own special attack (two stages).

spdef_down.doc: Lowers the foe's special defense one stage.

spdef_down_big.doc: Sharply lowers the foe's special defense (two stages).

spdef_down_self.doc: Lowers its own special defense after the attack.

spdef_up.doc: Raises its own special defense one stage.

spdef_up_big.doc: Sharply raises its own special defense (two stages).

speed_aura.doc: Skill: rarely caught by the foe's first strike.

speed_down.doc: Lowers the foe's speed one stage.

speed_down_big.doc: Sharply lowers the foe's speed (two stages).

speed_down_self.doc: Lowers its own speed after the attack.

speed_scaling.doc: Power scales with the speed difference.

speed_up.doc: Raises its own speed one stage.

speed_up_big.doc: Sharply raises its own speed (two stages).

stab_up.doc: Skill: its own-type bonus is x2 instead of x1.5.

start_damage.doc: Skill: chips the foe as the battle opens.

start_sun.doc: Skill: brings the sun as the battle opens.

status_immune_one.doc: Skill: immune to one status condition.

status_power.doc: Skill: attack x1.5 with a status condition.

status_speed.doc: Skill: speed x1.5 with a status condition.

stockpile.doc: Stores power for Spit Up and Swallow (up to 3).

sturdy.doc: Skill: survives one knockout blow from full HP with 1 HP.

substitute.doc: A decoy with a quarter of its HP takes the hits.

swap_defenses.doc: Swaps defense and special defense for 5 turns.

swap_focus.doc: Swaps focus meters with the foe.

swap_stats.doc: Swaps stats or stat changes with the foe.

taunt.doc: Taunt: the foe can only attack for 3 turns.

terrain_electric.doc: Electric terrain: Lightning moves up, no sleep.

terrain_grassy.doc: Grassy terrain: heals a little each turn, Grass moves up.

terrain_misty.doc: Misty terrain: no status conditions, Dragon moves down.

terrain_psychic.doc: Psychic terrain: no priority moves, Psychic moves up.

thick_fat.doc: Skill: Fire and Ice moves do half.

transform.doc: Becomes a copy of the foe: moves, pools and stats.

transform_start.doc: Skill: may transform for free on its first turn.

trap.doc: Trapped: can't flee or disengage; bound moves deal damage each turn.

tri_status.doc: One in five each: burn, freeze or paralysis.

trick_room.doc: For 5 turns the slower one acts first.

weak_armor.doc: Skill: a physical hit lowers its defense and raises its speed.

weaken_type.doc: Halves one type's damage (Mud Sport: Lightning; Water Sport: Fire).

weakness_bonus.doc: Skill: the foe's weakness counts double again.

weakness_reduce.doc: Skill: its weakness does a quarter less.

weather_cure.doc: Skill: rain cures its status conditions.

weather_power.doc: Skill: special power x1.5 in the sun, losing a little HP each turn.

weather_rain.doc: Rain for 5 turns: Water up, Fire down; Thunder never misses.

weather_snow.doc: Snow or hail for 5 turns; Blizzard never misses.

weather_speed.doc: Skill: speed x2 in its weather.

weather_sun.doc: Sun for 5 turns: Fire up, Water down; Solar Beam skips its commit.

wind.doc: A wind move (whirls up leaves and grass).

sim_targets._doc: Targets for the text battle simulator (many battles on the real energy v2 rules). Rarer is allowed to win; peers must stay close; Ash should feel stronger with every level, evolution and slot.

rarity_step_winrate.doc: a species one rarity step up, at the same level and stage, wins this share against the step below (a clear, not absurd, step)

within_tier_winrate.doc: within one rarity at a similar level, no common or uncommon's average win rate against its peers leaves this band

sim_targets.within_tier_spread_doc: the gap between the best and worst average win rate in a tier and level band

evolution_step_winrate.doc: an evolved form against its previous stage at the evolution level

level_step_winrate.doc: a species against itself ten levels lower

slot_unlock_winrate.doc: the same species with one more equip slot

sim_targets.doc_first_mover: the side that acts first should not win much more than half
sim_targets.doc_move_pick: no single move should be more than this share of a species' picks across battles (choice stays real)

dodge_success.doc: a Dodge against an attack that doesn't ignore it

battle_turns.doc: a typical wild battle's length in turns
